newsitem.title: USA: Roc holds 8.7 pct Chateau Properties stake.
newsitem.headline: Roc holds 8.7 pct Chateau Properties stake.

text.p: Roc Communities Inc said Wednesday it holds an 8.7 percent stake in Chateau Properties Inc or 565,815 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Roc said its latest transactions include the purchase of 118,700 common shares bought between Oct. 14 and Oct. 15 at prices ranging from $25.125 to $25.50 per share.
On Oct. 14, ROC began making open market purchases of and says it intends to continue buying shares, up to the maximum permitted amount of seven percent of the outstanding shares, the filing said.
While ROC may be deemed to beneficially own a total of 565,815 shares, ROC continues to disclaim ownership of 447,115 of those shares, the filing said.
Such percentage is based on 6,099,710 shares actually outstanding, plus 420,000 shares subject to the Chateau option which are deemed to be outstanding, the filing said.
